blocks.text: SEOUL, South Korea—South Korea will file criminal complaints against students caught cheating on a national university entrance exam with smart glasses. It also intends to toughen penalties for their use, a government official told AFP Friday. Sales of smart glasses — which allow the wearer to shoot photos and videos, and interact with an AI assistant among other abilities — are growing worldwide. But so is a backlash around the gadgets, including concerns over people being filmed without consent and their use by exam cheats.
